cases.purpose: Retain the historical ext4 algebra sequence and independently snapshot ioctl flags on both files after each operation; also exercise reversed operators, conflicting masks, and incompatible assignment without modifying files.
cases.oracle: e2fsprogs 1.47.2 chattr, flags read with e2fsprogs lsattr
cases.comparison: Byte parity with e2fsprogs 1.47.2 status and diagnostics, lsattr output, and independent FS_IOC_GETFLAGS snapshots for both files; setup or snapshot failure is not a pass.
cases.script:
strip() { /usr/bin/sed -E 's/^[^:]*: line [0-9]+: //' "$1" | /usr/bin/tr '\n' '|'; }
show() { printf '%s status=%s out=' "$1" "$2"; /usr/bin/tr '\n' '|' < /tmp/rf.out; printf ' err='; strip /tmp/rf.err; echo; }
r() { local l=$1; shift; "$@" >/tmp/rf.out 2>/tmp/rf.err; show "$l" $?; }
u() { local g=--clear-groups; [[ $3 ]] && g=--groups=$3
  /usr/bin/setpriv --reuid=2000 --regid=2000 $g -- "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c "$2" >/tmp/rf.out 2>/tmp/rf.err; show "$1" $?; }
I=/tmp/root-fixture.img M=/tmp/root-fixture-mnt
/usr/bin/truncate -s 4M $I && /usr/sbin/mkfs.ext4 -q -F -O ^has_journal $I && /usr/bin/mkdir $M && /usr/bin/mount -o loop $I $M || { echo SETUP-FAILED; exit 99; }
cd $M
lsa() { for f in "$@"; do /usr/bin/lsattr -d "$f" 2>&1 | /usr/bin/sed -E 's/^[^:]*: line [0-9]+: //'; done | /usr/bin/tr '\n' '|'; echo; }
snapshot() { /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import fcntl, struct, sys; fmt = "@l"; request = (2 << 30) | (struct.calcsize(fmt) << 16) | (ord("f") << 8) | 1
for p in sys.argv[1:]:
 with open(p, "rb") as f:
  data = fcntl.ioctl(f.fileno(), request, struct.pack(fmt, 0))
  print("%s flags=%08x" % (p, struct.unpack(fmt, data)[0]))' f1 f2 || exit 98; }
printf 'a\n' > f1; printf 'b\n' > f2; snapshot
echo "initial: $(lsa f1 f2)"
r add-two chattr +dA f1 f2;  echo "  $(lsa f1 f2)"; snapshot
r remove-one chattr -A f1;   echo "  $(lsa f1 f2)"; snapshot
r assign chattr =d f2;       echo "  $(lsa f1 f2)"; snapshot
r assign-with-e chattr =de f2; echo "  $(lsa f2)"; snapshot
r compose chattr +d -A f1;   echo "  $(lsa f1)"; snapshot
r compose2 chattr -d +A f1;  echo "  $(lsa f1)"; snapshot
r repeat-1 chattr +d f1;     echo "  $(lsa f1)"; snapshot
r repeat-2 chattr +d f1;     echo "  $(lsa f1)"; snapshot
r multi-op chattr +s +S f2;  echo "  $(lsa f2)"; snapshot
r assign-empty chattr = f1;  echo "  $(lsa f1)"; snapshot
r reverse chattr -A +d f1; snapshot
r conflict chattr +d -d f1; snapshot
r conflict-reverse chattr -A +A f1; snapshot
r assignment-mixed chattr =d +A f1; snapshot
r assignment-multiple chattr =d =A f1; snapshot
cd /tmp/parity-case && /usr/bin/umount $M && /usr/bin/rm -f $I && echo teardown=ok
